adjudicated.en: Kurosu.
comments: See CCD1001, though technically readers could get here without seeing that. Expanded and adapted: Kurosu<->Cross<->X is more important for the English reader to remember. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: Kurosu replaces the source’s displayed CROSS at a point where the surrounding sequence already supplies Cross, X, crossing, and the surname relation. It changes the visible term but strengthens one legitimate branch of the same name-and-cross chain, making the choice debatable rather than plainly erroneous.
adjudicated.remedy: Preserve both CROSS and Kurosu if the typography permits.
